blender: >= 4.2 (built/verified on estate pin 5.2.3 LTS; source tutorial on 5.0.1)

chain: Points to Volume (density: 1.0, voxel size = radius / resolution)
Set Material (shot material; debug material while shaping)

group_inputs.Radius: strand girth in metres; the only per-shot geometry knob besides the path

construction.input: Bezier curve path authored against the body surface (anchor-to-anchor per Plan 06 record)

determinism: Full: no bake, no cache, no seed. Identical inputs evaluate identically; renders verified by decoded-pixel hash across processes (Pass 3).
hard_limits: No motion is simulated: no flow, no fall, no pooling, no separation. Animation = authored curve states re-evaluated per frame (no bake).
No collision: strands stay out of bodies only because paths are authored on the surface (Plan 06 GAP 2 checklist applies).
Not a substitute for the Plan 07 Mantaflow route on emission/travel or free-dynamics shot classes; see PASS4-APPLICATION.md A/B.

material.final: Source recipe (pane-read, OBSERVATION C-09b): Principled BSDF white, roughness 0.0, transmission weight 1.0, IOR 1.5; Principled Volume density 30 in the volume socket; alpha driven by Light Path Ray Length (transfer curve UNREADABLE). Estate adoption is ADAPT (TECHNIQUE T-15): structure transfers, look gated by Owner eye; the geometry preset stays material-agnostic.
material.while_shaping: high-contrast debug material (source: M_ShowerGel first form, Principled, green, roughness 0.5, IOR 1.5)

radius_classes_m._note: Screen values from the source tutorial at its scene scale (proxy sphere diameter 2 m; Daz-proportioned character). Re-measure against fleet proportions before production use; classes are ratios of intent (4:1), not universal constants.
